snippet.title: Vohenn - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
App Store:
https://apps.apple.com/app/vohenn/id6752013060

Google Play:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Alper.Vohenn

After a violent storm wrecks his ship, Vohenn awakens on a mysterious isle once protected by elemental forces, now consumed by darkness. Guided by echoes of a lost power, he sets out to uncover the secret of the shattered Harmonic Stone and the power that turned the island against itself.

Built for mobile from the ground up, Vohenn combines precise 2D action-platforming with Metroidvania-style exploration. Every corner of the island offers hidden rewards, inviting players to explore, uncover its secrets, and shape their own journey.

🎵 Trailer music by AlkaKrab
